title: Environmental and Biodiversity Studies of Forest along Sungei Serangoon in Light of Construction Works
what_it_is: Environmental and Biodiversity Studies of Forest along Sungei Serangoon in Light of Construction Works

sections.label: Sungei Serangoon bus depot environment
sections.summary: Minister says the bus depot is on a brownfield site with non-native vegetation, so no environmental study was required, and LTA will put in place earth control and wildlife management measures.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development whether any Environmental Impact Assessment has been carried out or any Environmental Management and Monitoring Plan has been put in place prior to the start of the construction works for the bus depot at the forest along Sungei Serangoon between Tampines Road and Buangkok East Drive.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development whether URA would consider conducting baseline biodiversity studies of the forest along Sungei Serangoon from Tampines Road to Serangoon East Dam to study the biodiversity of the area for future planning purposes before any other project is approved on the site.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The bus depot will be constructed on a brownfield site comprising non-native vegetation and is not near any sensitive nature areas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: As such, the potential impact on sensitive habitats was assessed to be limited and an environmental study was not required.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: To mitigate any localised environmental impact, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) will put in place earth control and wildlife management measures during the construction.

sections.label: Industrial site zoning and construction disamenities
sections.summary: The site has been zoned for industrial use since 1998 and is intended as a new node for jobs closer to homes, with LTA working with the contractor to mitigate construction disamenities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The other part was also that this site has been zoned for industrial use since 1998 and it is intended to be developed into a new node in the area to provide for jobs closer to homes and for residents of the nearby towns such as Hougang, Sengkang and future residents as well.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: With regard to the potential disamenities as a result of the construction of the bus dept, LTA will work with the contractor to mitigate any of these.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: And I understand that there are already discussions about how to mitigate disamenities arising from the construction.
